name: Sketchpad interactive geometric constraints
description: An interactive graphics system let users draw on a display and apply geometric constraints that the computer maintained as the drawing changed.

date.basis: Date or approximate interval stated by the source for this event.

events.statement: Sutherland submitted his Sketchpad dissertation in January 1963, documenting a working TX-2 graphics system with constraints.

evidence.supports: Names Sutherland and describes the system.
Cambridge dates the dissertation and describes movable drawing parts subject to user constraints.
Conference paper describes light-pen drawing and maintained geometric relationships.

earliest_record.rationale: Earliest dated event established in the cited sources for this scoped record; it does not assert global priority.

caveats: This documents research use on a particular laboratory computer, not public access or every subsequent graphical interface.

research.note: Source-backed initial research; independent review is pending. Independent reader checked Cambridge’s dissertation submission date and description; date is not asserted as first operation.
